incentives.title: Keep more of what you *earn*
incentives.intro: Act 60 may offer qualifying residents preferential Puerto Rico income-tax treatment on certain interest, dividends and post-residency capital appreciation.
incentives.program: Puerto Rico's Act 60 Resident Individual Investor program may offer preferential Puerto Rico income-tax treatment to eligible individuals who establish bona fide residency. Qualifying applicants filing by December 31, 2026 may receive 0% Puerto Rico income tax on certain interest, dividends and post-residency capital appreciation through December 31, 2035. Applications filed beginning January 1, 2027 generally fall under a 4% regime extending through December 31, 2055. Eligibility, income sourcing, federal tax rules and decree compliance apply.

0.text: Potential Puerto Rico rate for qualifying 2026 applicants; benefits generally expire December 31, 2035.

1.text: Preferential Puerto Rico rate for qualifying applications filed from January 1, 2027.

2.text: End of the extended 4% program period, not the end date of the original 0% decree.

incentives.ratesNote: Rates apply only to qualifying Puerto Rico income-tax treatment under an approved decree; they are not US federal rates. The 0% and 4% regimes are separate: a 2026 decree does not continue automatically at 4% after 2035.
incentives.calcIntro: Possible federal long-term capital gains tax compared with preferential Puerto Rico income-tax treatment for fully qualifying post-residency gains. These figures are examples, not estimates of your personal tax liability or guaranteed savings.

calc.title: Act 60 calculator
calc.note: Federal figure uses the top 20% long-term capital gains rate plus 3.8% NIIT. Actual treatment depends on tax residency, sourcing, pre-relocation appreciation, federal and Puerto Rico rules, and decree terms. Consult qualified tax counsel.

incentives.residencyIntro: The IRS generally requires all three of the following. Other presence tests and year-of-move rules may apply; day counting alone is not enough.

0.title: Presence
0.text: A qualifying presence test, often 183 days in Puerto Rico in the tax year.

1.title: Tax home
1.text: Your tax home, your main place of work or business, is in Puerto Rico.

2.title: Closer connection
2.text: No closer connection to the United States or another foreign country.

steps.0: Review eligibility with an independent Puerto Rico tax professional.
steps.1: Submit a complete decree application through the official DDEC Incentives Portal.
steps.2: Establish bona fide Puerto Rico residency and satisfy the applicable primary-residence acquisition requirement.
steps.3: Maintain the decree's annual reporting, charitable-contribution and other compliance obligations.

incentives.stepsNote: The primary-residence commitment is generally to acquire a home within two years after the decree; applications filed from 2027 have specific ownership and title rules. Buying a residence, including at Tesoro del Mar, does not by itself qualify you or automatically satisfy the rule.

0.title: December 31
0.text: DDEC guidance states that eligible applications received by 11:59 p.m. on December 31, 2026, based on the Incentives Portal filing-fee timestamp, retain the substantive terms in effect at filing even if approved later. Timely filing does not guarantee approval or replace residency and compliance requirements.

1.title: Established under Puerto Rico law
1.text: Act 60 tax decrees are issued by the Government of Puerto Rico and define the applicable benefits and obligations. Decrees remain subject to eligibility, compliance, governing law and potential revocation.

2.title: Independent tax advisers
2.text: Every situation is specific. ORA World can connect you with independent Puerto Rico tax advisers to review yours.

incentives.disclaimer: General information, not tax or legal advice, and not an offer of tax results. Based on Act 60 as amended by Act 38-2026, DDEC Bulletin 2026-004 and IRS Publication 570. ORA World can connect you with independent Puerto Rico tax advisers; consult qualified tax counsel about your situation.

longevity.question: What is the value of an extra ten years for you?
longevity.questionText: Time and health are the real investment. Tell us your goals; we'll show you how ORA World makes them easy.
longevity.planesText: Two things keep them up: redundancy and preventive maintenance. You have two lungs and two kidneys, so you have redundancy, but no preventive maintenance: most people see a doctor only when something hurts. ORA checks you before anything breaks, so what can be caught early, like heart issues, is caught early.
longevity.selfText: Some people look 50 or 60 at 80; others look old at 60. Around 50 is the age to start: how do you make yourself at 50 feel like 30 or 35? The aim is to be among the strongest and fittest for your age.
